package.welcome_message: Land in Amman, then 3 exploring days through Petra, then Wadi Rum (2 days).

trip.title: Petra · Wadi Rum
trip.summary: Arrival, then Petra, then Wadi Rum (2 days). Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

planning.strategy: You land at 21:46, so arrival night stays in Amman — hotel, a meal, rest. The touring days start the next morning. I put Wadi Rum on the calendar first, then kept the rest of the days on Petra, then Wadi Rum (2 days). It's a hot month, so the outdoor sites go before midday.

meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights=2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Petra, Wadi Rum. Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: Petra→cluster 1 (Ma'an Governorate · culture, history); Wadi Rum→cluster 0 (Ma'an Governorate · culture, history)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Petra part 1 → D2:C1/Petra part 2 → D3:C2/Petra part 3
- mustVisit entity lock: Wadi Rum→lead with Wadi Rum Visitor Center (cluster 0)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C0: Rum Village Bedouin Oasis + Desert Police Station & Fort (Wadi Rum)
- Lodging requested: rating=4 star, type=hotel. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): no hotel card — state lodging is not covered; N2(C1): Petra Panorama Hotel [4-star]
- Money: 900 JOD covers 5 traveller(s) for 3 days (≈300 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 2 night(s) x ~3 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority=budget → take the cheaper of two comparable options and note the saving. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.
